source_caption:
Christopher Nolan’s behind-the-scenes work has become almost as famous as his films because he often builds the impossible for real. From the rotating hallway in Inception to practical explosions, massive sets, and large-format IMAX photography, his movies stand out because the spectacle feels physical — like the audience is watching cinema happen in front of the camera, not just inside a computer.

A body of work defined by ambition, practical filmmaking, and mind-bending storytelling, turning time, memory, identity, and obsession into some of the most cinematic experiences of modern film.

source_details.title: Inception
source_details.synopsis: Inception is a 2010 science fiction heist film written and directed by Christopher Nolan, who also produced it with his wife Emma Thomas. The film stars Leonardo DiCaprio as a professional thief who steals information by infiltrating his targets' subconscious. He is offered a chance to have his criminal history erased as payment for implanting an idea into a target's subconscious. The ensemble cast includes Ken Watanabe, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Marion Cotillard, Elliot Page, Tom Hardy, Cillian Murphy, Tom Berenger, Dileep Rao, and Michael Caine.
